page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks position this instance in the average tier for most compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1861.39 and a multi-core score of 15552.92. Memory bandwidth tests show 850.62 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 98.25 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Notably, the instance demonstrates strong performance in small-scale language model text generation, achieving 265.61 tokens/sec with a 135M model, though performance scales down to 11.61 tokens/sec for a medium 7B model.

The qualitative cost profile of the ecs.r7t.4xlarge reflects its high memory density relative to compute resources, making it a resource-efficient option for memory-bound workloads that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage. The absence of local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, limiting its utility for heavy data science training or high-I/O database operations requiring local scratch space. It is best suited for in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis, enterprise applications, and moderate web serving.
